observations: The lower pin-3 NAND gate is labeled D105, not D7.
D105.3's output line runs east near source y3360 and turns north near (1398,3360).
D7.11's separate output line runs east near source y3590, roughly 230 px below the D105.3 turn. No local stroke or filled junction joins these two outputs in the native crop.
The earlier D7.3/D7.11 tie came from misreading the D105 reference; the later D7.11/D105.3 tie came from following the wrong vertical stroke.
model_disposition: Keep D7.11/PROM_EN and D105.3/qualified IOWR separate. A remote or factory-modified join would require independent board continuity; the visible source detail does not demand one.
physical_limit: The native crop establishes only local drawn separation. The original board has no recorded direct D7.11-to-D105.3 continuity measurement.
